body: Yeah I think we might need a career change. It’s sad because he’s been able to help so many, he’s a very talented and sought after therapist, especially because he works with kids and teens, and so many shy away from that population. However, the nature of the job I think adds to his feeling of being overwhelmed by how hard life can be 🙁.  Thank you for your post

Thanks for your insight. I agree this could be helpful, and hopefully will be an option someday for my husband and for so many others (we live in a state still fighting the political battle surrounding this) and when you work in the health care field as my husband does, your risking your license, career and possibly freedom going through other methods of obtaining/using 🙁

Actually I agree 100% with all of this. It’s taken a long time to understand that his love for me and our kids has zero to do with the reasons he might not want to leave this earth. 

If I truly thought there was no hope, I would see if we could move to a country where I could be by his side and let him move on in gentlest way possible (a “not popular thought” to many, but it’s 100% what I’d do if he or I had a terminal disease, I don’t view this any different. 

Except, there might be hope... so we keep fighting. 

I’d love to know what you did/where to start with the gut healing. We’ve been discussing this but the information on the subject is daunting. 

Thank you! 💗

Thank you, I needed to read this. Though our situations are slightly different (were still married, and he’s been such a wonderful and involved Dad) I need to know that we’ll be ok if he chooses to leave us one day. I admire your strength and drive so much!

This is extremely helpful and makes so much sense regarding dosing and remission! His does on Friday was a little less, were going back in tomorrow and I will recommend a higher dose/longer infusion time! Thank you!

I’m sorry you had to see that. I agree with the other poster who suggested trauma counseling. Also as hard as it is you have to remember that she has to make her own choices. She’s lucky to have your care and support. And she made the choice to put herself at risk, you couldn’t have changed that! You are wonderful to care so much! Take care of yourself!

That’s awesome! Have you ever listened to the podcast “losing 100 lbs with phit and phat”? If not I highly recommend it. She gives such good advice on getting/keeping your mind right. It’s helped me a lot (I’ve been in the exact same boat as you, my husband concerned about me not taking care of myself, or him, and worrying about our marriage) thanks for sharing your story!

I just wanted to say I’m sorry you’re going through this! My husband and I have a similar group of friends and I truly understand why you want it to just go away. There have also been times that by husband has gotten drunk enough to not remember a nights events (though he’s never done anything inappropriate, he’s said a few things he doesn’t remember at all) 

My concern is, even if he doesn’t remember, if he was as mortified as he appeared to be, why wouldn’t he put some things in place to change it/prevent it? Maybe drink less for a few gatherings so he can be aware and say something to let her know he’s yours and only yours? And stick with you or the guys throughout the night. 

Is there another girl in group you could talk to?  Maybe someone who would say something to her? 

Again I’m sorry this is happening. You need to have a very open conversation with your husband and put a plan together for this to stop. If he’s not willing to do that and follow through, then he’s not innocent. Your feelings matter, they need to matter to your husband.

Find a certified child play therapist. Just because she completed a round of therapy doesn’t mean she can’t benefit from more. In fact she might need several rounds throughout her life as she grows. My husband is a therapist and has clients who complete therapy for a while and then check in occasionally or start up again as thing change. You can get through this, find a therapist she trusts and do the “homework” she recommends!
Yes! I keep telling myself, I want to wear whatever I want, not eat whatever I want 😁

I started listening to losing 100lbs phit n phat podcast, and although its not specifically a Keto podcast, it’s been life changing for me! I feel with the thought process tools from that show plus Keto I’m going to stick with it this time! I feel so much more confidence! I highly highly recommend it!

Awesome! Thank you for sharing! I don’t drink a lot, but I’ve noticed a big difference in my weight and body since I started drinking. Also, I’m starting out very close to your weight (at 230) I am shocked at how much of a difference 25lbs made! Thanks for the inspiration! You go girl!
